recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E：濾泡小、生發中心萎縮並被同心圓狀排列的外套區細胞包圍（onion-skin），濾泡間富含血管與漿細胞，高倍下可見核大、核仁明顯的漿母細胞混在漿細胞之間，符合 HIV 相關多中心 Castleman 病（HHV8+ MCD）。
features: A: low power lymph node with preserved capsule and a small follicle with atrophic (regressed) germinal center and mildly expanded mantle zone
B: follicle with concentric onion-skin layering of mantle zone lymphocytes around a hyalinized/regressed germinal center
C: expanded interfollicular area with increased vascularity and a polymorphous plasmacytic infiltrate
D: high power showing sheets of mature plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei admixed with larger plasmablasts with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm
No effacement of nodal architecture by confluent sheets of large cells
describe_en: Lymph node sections (H&E) show preserved nodal architecture with a small follicle containing an atrophic, regressed germinal center and a mildly expanded mantle zone (A). At higher power, mantle zone lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around the regressed germinal center (B). The interfollicular region is expanded by increased vascularity and a dense plasmacytic infiltrate (C), which at high power comprises mature plasma cells admixed with larger plasmablasts showing vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm (D). Confluent sheets of large atypical cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with HIV-associated (HHV8-positive) multicentric Castleman disease; HHV8 LANA-1 immunostaining of mantle zone plasmablasts is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: iMCD shows similar regressed follicles and sheets of interfollicular plasma cells but lacks LANA-1-positive plasmablasts and occurs in HIV/HHV8-negative patients.
HIV lymphadenitis shows florid follicular hyperplasia with follicle lysis early and lymphocyte depletion late, without mantle zone LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.
Hyaline-vascular UCD is a localized mass with twin germinal centers, lollipop hyalinized vessels and prominent follicular dendritic cells, but lacks sheets of plasma cells and systemic symptoms.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%) with elevated serum IgG4 and no HHV8 infection.

captions: A: Small follicle with atrophic germinal center and expanded mantle zone
B: Concentric onion-skin mantle zone around a regressed germinal center
C: Vascular interfollicular area with plasma cell infiltrate
D: Plasma cells and plasmablasts at high power
